invariants.rationale: The method requires access to clusteringGroup methods and fields, which must not be null.
strategyParams is passed down to other method calls and likely must not be null.
instantTime is used to read records and must represent a valid instant, so null is likely not allowed.
instantTime must be a non-empty string representing a timestamp or commit instant.
Clustering would only be performed if there is at least one output file group to write to.
